class.name: SnapshotRotationSmoothing3D
class.brief_description: Bounded shortest-arc Hermite rotation interpolation for network simulated proxies.
class.description: Pure 3D character-yaw smoothing inspired by Unreal Engine simulated-proxy NetworkSmoothingMode. It reconstructs turns between two authoritative server samples using optional angular velocities from neighboring samples, without extrapolation. The game owns arrival timing and histories; this class never changes a Node3D, physics or networking state.

method.name: interpolate_yaw
method.description: Returns the interpolated yaw on the shortest rotation arc. Fractions are clamped to [0, 1]; valid endpoint rotations are preserved modulo 2*pi, without seam jumps. Nonfinite/invalid angles fall back to the valid endpoint or zero. Turns above 2.4 radians, bad spans outside (0.00001, 0.5] seconds or nonfinite/unbounded angular velocities use a safe shortest-arc linear interpolation. Otherwise computes an endpoint-tangent Hermite cubic with directional slopes clamped to [0, 3] chords, and final angle clamped between unwrapped endpoints. No overshoot, future prediction, 360-degree wrap or gameplay state mutation. Values are in radians and seconds.
